subject: general
question: In which sport Mariyappan Thangavelu and Sharad Kumar won silver and bronze medals at Tokyo Paralympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**High jump**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's remarkable performance at the **Tokyo Paralympics **persisted as** Mariyappan Thangavelu and Sharad Kumar** clinched silver and bronze respectively in the men's high jump T63 event.
 
• **Sharad cleared 1.83m,** while Mariyappan achieved his best clearance at 1.86m.
 
• U.S. athlete Sam Grewe, the reigning world champion, secured gold by clearing 1.88m on his third attempt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• With this achievement,** India's medal tally** at the **Paralympics now stands at 10**, comprising **two golds, five silvers, and three bronzes.**
 
• Notably, Mariyappan had previously secured gold in this event at the Rio Paralympics, with Varun Singh Bhati earning bronze and Sharad finishing sixth. In the Tokyo event, Bhati secured 7th place after clearing 1.77m.
 
• This event mirrored the success of the 2016 Paralympics, with India claiming two of the three podium spots.
 
• Mariyappan now joins Joginder Singh Bedi and Devendra Jhajharia as one of the few Indians to win multiple medals at the Paralympics, with Jhajharia and Bedi each having secured three medals.
